footnote_text: The restricted stock units ("RSUs") shall vest as to 10% of the shares on December 9, 2026 and every three months thereafter for three quarters, as to 7.5% of the shares every three months thereafter for four quarters, as to 5% of the shares every three months thereafter for four quarters, and as to 2.5% of the shares every three months thereafter for four quarters, such that the shares are fully vested on approximately the four (4) year anniversary of the date of grant. || The shares represent RSUs that were received as an award, for no consideration.
